character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every scene: sun-bleached sandy hair beneath a weathered hat, copper-brown eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a canyon trail guide who reads the changing light on ancient stone. Signature costume: a sand-colored canvas duster, rust-red scarf, utility belt, and hiking boots. Defining personal item: a small polished canyon-stone talisman. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with burnt orange, rust red, sand gold, sky blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow upward tilt along curved sandstone walls, tracking through a narrow slot canyon, wide aerial view of layered red cliffs; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
